From 70af6c5b5270e8101f318c4b69cc98a726edfab9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yangtao Li <tiny.windzz@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Dec 2018 08:14:42 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] clk: qoriq: fix refcount leak in clockgen_init()

The of_find_compatible_node() returns a node pointer with refcount
incremented, but there is the lack of use of the of_node_put() when
done. Add the missing of_node_put() to release the refcount.

Signed-off-by: Yangtao Li <tiny.windzz@gmail.com>
Fixes: 0dfc86b3173f ("clk: qoriq: Move chip-specific knowledge into driver")
Signed-off-by: Stephen Boyd <sboyd@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/clk/clk-qoriq.c b/drivers/clk/clk-qoriq.c
index 4c30b6e799ed..97a0029a1cca 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/clk-qoriq.c
+++ b/drivers/clk/clk-qoriq.c
@@ -1389,6 +1389,7 @@ static void __init clockgen_init(struct device_node *np)
 				pr_err("%s: Couldn't map %pOF regs\n", __func__,
 				       guts);
 			}
+			of_node_put(guts);
 		}
 
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/clk/clk-qoriq.c`**
- A new line was added to the `clockgen_init` function to call `of_node_put(guts);`. This line is responsible for releasing the reference count of the node pointer returned by `of_find_compatible_node()`, which was previously not being released, leading to a reference count leak.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a bug related to memory management in the `clockgen_init` function. The addition of `of_node_put(guts);` ensures that the reference count of the node pointer is properly decremented after its use, thus preventing a potential memory leak that could occur if the reference count is not managed correctly. This change is directly related to the previous implementation that incremented the reference count without a corresponding decrement, as noted in the commit message.

of_node_put(guts);
